basis.interpretation: Central chest pressure is a cardinal symptom of acute coronary syndrome and requires emergency evaluation

basis.quote: it's going into my left arm
basis.interpretation: Radiation to the left arm is a classic feature associated with myocardial infarction and acute ischemia

basis.quote: I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach
basis.interpretation: Diaphoresis and nausea are autonomic symptoms commonly accompanying acute coronary events
High cholesterol is a significant risk factor for coronary artery disease
